title: Chain Discourse
tagline: A decentralized communication platform that leverages blockchain technology for secure, transparent, and censorship-resistant discussions
description: Chain Discourse is a cutting-edge decentralized communication platform designed to revolutionize the way communities interact online. By leveraging blockchain technology, Chain Discourse offers a secure, transparent, and censorship-resistant environment for discussions and collaborations.
how_its_made: I developed the decentralized application (dApp) using React for the frontend and styled it with Tailwind CSS to create a beautiful user interface. For the smart contract development, I utilized Hardhat, a powerful toolchain for Ethereum development, to write and deploy smart contract.
